title: Genetic Mapping Tutorial
text: LDdecay R package linkage disequilibrium (LD) analysis visualization. package provides tools calculating genome-wide LD decay, generating empirical binned LD-decay curves, visualizing regional LD patterns, mapping SNPs nearby genomic features, integrating LD information GFF3 gene annotations. package designed primarily genomic analysis crop species, soybean examples Williams 82 genome annotations provided part workflow.

title: Genetic Mapping Tutorial

title: Genetic Mapping Tutorial
text: sn​p_to_gene_mapping_using_gff3_annot() identifies genes located within specified physical window around target SNPs. example: Inspect results: returned table includes information : query SNP chromosome SNP position gene ID gene symbol gene coordinates strand distance SNP upstream/downstream/overlapping orientation gene description example: query_snp snp_chr snp_pos gene_id gene_symbol start end strand distance_to_snp orientation description

what: 9. Plot LD and Gene Annotations in a Regional Area of Interest
title: Genetic Mapping Tutorial
text: plot_snp_ld_region_and_genes() combines regional LD information gene models GFF3 annotation. produces composite figure containing: Gene models across genomic region. Candidate genes matching user-defined annotation pattern. Significant SNP locations. Regional pairwise LD. Physical genomic coordinates. Example: resulting object contains several useful components: Display complete figure: automatically displayed without even running code
code: result <- plot_snp_ld_region_and_genes(   map = map,   geno = geno,   gff_table = gff_table,   chromosome = "Gm03",   focal_snp = "ss715620779",   ld_window = 50000,   gene_name = "ABC/PDR Transport",   gene_pattern = "ABC-2/plant PDR ABC transporter|ABC|PDR transporter" ) result$plot result$gene_plot result$ld_plot result$genes result$cyp_genes result$marker_map result$significant_map result$r2 result$ld_data result$plot

title: Calculate and Plot Binned Empirical Linkage Disequilibrium Decay — plot_binned_ld_global_decay
text: geno data frame matrix containing genotype dosages. data must contain column named "taxa" identifying individual samples, remaining columns corresponding variant identifiers. Genotype values numeric dosage values 0, 1, 2. map data frame containing physical coordinates variants. data frame must contain columns named "SNP", "Chromosome", "Position", corresponding variant identifiers, chromosome assignments, physical positions base pairs, respectively. bin_size_bp Numeric value specifying width physical-distance bins used summarize pairwise LD. value expressed base pairs. Default 10000 (10 kb). max_distance_bp Numeric value specifying maximum physical distance pairwise LD calculated displayed. value expressed base pairs. Default 500000 (500 kb). r2_threshold Numeric value specifying \(r^2\) threshold displayed horizontal dashed reference line plot. Default 0.2. output_image_path Character string specifying file path generated plot saved. file extension determines output format supported ggsave. Set NULL return plot without saving image. Default "Figures/ld_binned_decay.png".

title: Calculate and Plot Binned Empirical Linkage Disequilibrium Decay — plot_binned_ld_global_decay
text: list containing two elements: plot ggplot object containing empirical LD decay   profile. binned_data data frame containing summarized LD values   physical-distance bin. Columns include bin, lower   boundary distance bin base pairs; mean_r2, mean   pairwise \(r^2\); median_r2, median pairwise \(r^2\);   count, number pairwise comparisons contributing bin.

title: Calculate and Plot Binned Empirical Linkage Disequilibrium Decay — plot_binned_ld_global_decay
text: Genotype physical-map data first synchronized using intersection marker identifiers present datasets. Unanchored scaffold chromosomes excluded, markers ordered chromosome physical position. Pairwise \(r^2\) values calculated markers chromosome within specified maximum physical distance. function calculates LD separately within chromosome calculate LD markers located different chromosomes. Markers located chromosomes whose names begin "scaffold" excluded analysis. markers present geno map retained. Markers ordered chromosome physical position pairwise comparisons performed. marker, function identifies downstream markers chromosome within max_distance_bp. Pairwise LD calculated squared Pearson correlation genotype dosage vectors using pairwise-complete observations. Pairwise LD values grouped physical-distance bins width bin_size_bp. bin, function calculates mean \(r^2\), median \(r^2\), number contributing marker pairs. resulting mean \(r^2\) values used construct empirical LD decay curve. small calculation buffer added internally requested maximum distance reduce edge effects assigning pairwise observations final distance bins. output_image_path NULL, output directory created automatically necessary plot saved 300 dpi.

title: Calculate and Plot Binned Empirical Linkage Disequilibrium Decay — plot_binned_ld_global_decay
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(LDdecay)  # Calculate empirical LD decay using 10-kb distance bins ld_decay <- plot_binned_ld_global_decay(   geno = geno,   map = map,   bin_size_bp = 10000,   max_distance_bp = 500000 )  # Display the LD decay plot ld_decay$plot  # Inspect the summarized LD data head(ld_decay$binned_data)  # Run the analysis without saving an image ld_decay <- plot_binned_ld_global_decay(   geno = geno,   map = map,   output_image_path = NULL ) } # }

what: Calculate and Plot Global Linkage Disequilibrium Decay — plot_global_ld_decay
title: Calculate and Plot Global Linkage Disequilibrium Decay — plot_global_ld_decay
text: Calculates genome-wide pairwise linkage disequilibrium (LD) squared Pearson correlations (\(r^2\)) genotype markers within user-defined physical distance. function synchronizes genotype marker-map data, removes unanchored scaffold markers, calculates pairwise \(r^2\) values within chromosomes, generates scatterplot LD physical distance. nonlinear least-squares (NLS) regression curve fitted using model \(r^2 = 1/(1 + C d)\), \(d\) physical distance \(C\) fitted decay parameter.

title: Calculate and Plot Global Linkage Disequilibrium Decay — plot_global_ld_decay
code: plot_global_ld_decay(   geno,   map,   max_distance_bp = 5e+05,   max_plot_points = 1e+05,   r2_threshold = 0.2,   output_image_path = "Figures/ld_short_range.png" )
